spans.s:
Satisfaction, success.
E.
दुह to milk, &c. affix घञ्.

n. (-जं)
Milk.
E.
दोह milking, and ज produced.

f. (-का)
The Prākṛta metre, commonly Doha; a stanza of four lines, containing thirteen and eleven syllabic instants alternately.

n. (-दं)
1 Wish, desire.
2 The longing of a pregnant woman, especially as a sign of impregnation.
E.
दोह here said to mean satisfaction, and द what gives.

n. (-णं)
1 The fœtus, the embryo, sometimes confounded with the womb.
2 The period of passing from one season of life to another, as from childhood to youth, from youth to manhood.
E.
दोहद longing, and लक्षण a sign.

f. (-ती)
A pregnant woman longing for any thing.
E.
दोहद as above, मतुप् aff.

f. (-ता)
A pregnant woman longing for any thing.
E.
दोहद as above, and अन्वित attached or become inherent.

nf. (-नं-नी)
A milk vessel, a milk pail.
n. (-नं)
Milking.
E.
दुह to milk, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-लः)
1 Wish, desire.
2 Longing.
f. (-ली)
The Asoka tree.
E.
दोह satisfaction, and ल what gets: see दोहद.

f. (-ती)
A pregnant woman longing for any thing: see दोहदवती.

m. (-यः)
Milk.
E.
दोह milking, अप below, णी to bring, affix अप्.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Milking, a milker.
E.
दुह to milk, घिनुण् aff.

mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः)
Yielding a great abundance of milk.
E.
दोह milk, ईयसुन् aff.

mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं)
To be milked, milkable.
E.
दुह to milk, ण्यत् affix; also दुह्य.
